00d53dd03ef941b6a9ad5703add0c687.name: ginger Cat
00d53dd03ef941b6a9ad5703add0c687.description:
A ginger cat, also known as an orange tabby or marmalade cat, is a domestic feline with a distinct coat color that ranges from a deep reddish-orange to a pale yellowish-orange. These cats are often recognizable by their bold and striking stripes or spots, which may be solid or broken, and can vary in size and shape.

Their fur is typically short and dense, providing them with a plush and velvety texture that is both soft to the touch and visually appealing. Their eyes, which may be green, amber, or yellow, often stand out against the warm hues of their fur, giving them an alert and curious expression.



Overall, ginger cats are a beloved and popular breed among cat enthusiasts, known for their striking appearance, charming personality, and loyal companionship.

122abfd70d84443698fb8ed0925a6fa1.name: Gustav Holst's Piano (LiDAR)
122abfd70d84443698fb8ed0925a6fa1.description:
This is a 3D model of the real piano used by Gustav Holst in the 1900s, created using LiDAR scanning with a Artec Leo 3D scanner. The scanner works by emitting laser pulses, measuring the time it takes for the reflected light to return to the scanner, and then calculating the distance using the speed of light. I  scanned the piano in sections, then stitching them together in software to create the final model. 

Created by Ryan McNab.

2721e946c7ac4ba2b1eb65aa99e2f77d.description:
A little small pumpkin

Boiled pumpkin

1/4 pumpkin
Water 100 ml
(A) 1 tablespoon of soy sauce
(A) 1 tablespoon of sake
(A) 1 tablespoon sugar
(A) Mirin 1 tablespoon

How to make!

1. Remove the pumpkin seeds.
2. Wrap it tightly on the pumpkin and heat it in the 600w range for 3 minutes and 30 seconds, then cut it into bite-sized pieces.
3. Put water, pumpkin and (A) in a pan, drop it, cover it and heat it over medium heat.
4. When it comes to normal, reduce the heat to low and simmer until the pumpkin is soft, and you're done!

5.Enjoy!

62954f4d59c34c11b22c62eab8cfad57.name: Pumpkin6
62954f4d59c34c11b22c62eab8cfad57.description:
Ingredients [For 2 people] 1/6 pumpkin (200g) 1/4 onion (50g) 1/4 teaspoon salt ☆Seasoning Mayonnaise 2 tablespoons Milk 1 tablespoon A little pepper

1.Remove seeds and pulp from pumpkin and cut into small bite-sized pieces. Put the pumpkin and water (not included in the ingredients: 1 tbsp) in a heat-resistant container, cover with plastic wrap, and heat in the microwave at 600W for 4-5 minutes until the pumpkin becomes soft. Remove the plastic wrap, add salt while still hot, and mash well until smooth to cool.

2.Cut the onion into thin slices lengthwise, put it in a separate heat-resistant container, wrap it loosely, and heat it in a 600W range for 1 minute. Take a rough fever.

3.Add onions and ☆ to a heat-resistant container and mix well.

4.Enjoy!
